verdict.rationale: Temporal is inherently headless. The official `temporal` CLI provides terminal access to manage, monitor and debug a Temporal Service, and it ships for macOS, Linux and Windows or as a Docker image. `temporal server start-dev` spins up a local service, a time-skipping test server supports end-to-end and integration tests, and Service Accounts and API keys enable non-interactive auth, all of which suit automated CI runs. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive/machine-readable CLI output, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
